lines.en: I head over to the archery range to find Tsuneyo practicing her form without the use of any actual arrows as she is afraid she may accidentally shoot a bird in transit.
lines.zh: 我前往射箭场，发现 Tsuneyo 正在不用任何真箭的情况下练习姿势，因为她怕不小心射中一只路过的鸟。

lines.en: Why she is worried about this when countless fowls have died at her hand, I do not know. But this is Tsuneyo we’re talking about, so I’m not going to ask any questions.
lines.zh: 无数禽类已死于她手，她却在担心这个，我不知道为什么。不过我们说的是 Tsuneyo，所以我不会问任何问题。

lines.en: Especially because I feel like she wouldn’t hesitate to shoot {i}me,{/i} transit or not.
lines.zh: 尤其是因为我觉得她要射{i}我{/i}的话不会犹豫，管它是不是路过。

lines.en: We talk a little bit about how she’s enjoying this club and how it's her first experience with anything like it since kendo.
lines.zh: 我们聊了聊她有多喜欢这个社团，以及这是她自剑道以来第一次体验类似的东西。

lines.en: Apparently, the only contact she had with other girls during her kendo career was during competitions, so this is still a lot different and, to her, much more fun.
lines.zh: 显然，她在剑道生涯中与其他女孩唯一的接触就是在比赛时，所以这里还是相当不同，对她来说也有趣得多。

lines.en: I question exactly how she became so {i}good{/i} at kendo without practicing against people her age but, as expected, she tells me it was all her father and that he is the one who trained her to be all she is today.
lines.zh: 我问她到底是怎么在不跟同龄人对练的情况下把剑道练得这么{i}好{/i}，不过不出所料，她说全是她父亲，是他把她训练成了今天的样子。

lines.en: Tsuneyo hands me her bow and asks me if I’d like to try taking a shot but, seeing as there are still no arrows to be found, I just...hold it and pull the string back a little bit.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把她的弓递给我，问我要不要试一箭，不过鉴于仍然找不到箭，我就……握着它，把弦往后拉了一点。

lines.en: It’s a satisfying feeling- one that’s hard to describe or compare to anything else. But what strikes me most is how heavy it feels and how she’s able to do this with no effort at all.
lines.zh: 那是一种令人满足的感觉——很难描述，也很难与别的东西相比。但最让我震撼的是它有多沉，而她做起来却毫不费力。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s a lot more to it than just strength alone but, if she’s anywhere as good at this as she was at her last sport, I’m excited to see more out of her one day.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定这不只是力量的问题，不过如果她在这上面有上一项运动一半的好，我就很期待有朝一日能看到她更多的表现。
